'''Railway Shrine''' (鉄道神社)

== Shrines named "Railway Shrine" ==
* {{ill|Railway Shrine (Kita, Tokyo)|ja|鉄道神社 (東京都北区)}} – Shrine located within the {{ill|East Japan Railway Company, Tōkyō Metropolitan Area Headquarters|ja|東日本旅客鉄道東京支社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR East Tokyo Branch|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 東日本旅客鉄道首都圏本部|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11527192}} in Kita Ward, Tokyo. Formerly located on the rooftop of the {{ill|JR East Headquarters Building|ja|JR東日本本社ビル#旧国鉄本社ビル|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/former Japanese National Railways Headquarters|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3156958}} in Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo.<ref>{{PDFlink|[http://www2.kokugakuin.ac.jp/ishii-rabo/data/pdf/199202.pdf 日本の企業と宗教]}} 石井研士</ref>
* {{ill|Railway Shrine (Yokohama)|ja|鉄道神社（神奈川県横浜市）}} – Shrine located in Ōkurayama Park (Ume-en) in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. Shrine of the Tokyu Group, enshrined from Ise Grand Shrine.
* {{ill|Tetsudo Shrine|ja|鉄道神社 (南牧村)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Railway Shrine (Minamimaki)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q30936255}} – Shrine near the highest elevation of JR Group railway lines (near Nobeyama Station) in Minamimaki Village, Minamisaku District, Nagano Prefecture.
* Railway Shrine (Osaka) – Shrine on the rooftop of the {{ill|JR West Japan Headquarters Building|ja|JR西日本本社ビル|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR West Headquarters|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11226320}} in Osaka, Osaka Prefecture. See {{ill|JR West Japan Headquarters Building|ja|JR西日本本社ビル#鉄道神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR West Headquarters#Railway Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11226320}}.
* {{ill|Tetsudō Shrine|ja|鉄道神社 (福岡市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Railway Shrine (Fukuoka)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q30932529}} – Shrine located on the rooftop of {{ill|JR Hakata City|ja|JR博多シティ|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR Hakata City|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11226208}} at Hakata Station in Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Tetsudō Shrine|ja|鉄道神社 (大分市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Railway Shrine (Oita)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q22119498}} – Shrine located on the rooftop of {{ill|AMU PLAZA OITA|ja|JRおおいたシティ|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/JR Ōita City|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to アミュプラザおおいた|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q18335584}} at Ōita Station in Ōita City, Ōita Prefecture.
* Japan Railway Shrine – Shrine located within the {{ill|Museum Yamato Bunkakan|en|Museum Yamato Bunkakan|qid=Q3329639|lt=Yamato Bunkakan}} in Nara City, Nara Prefecture. Adjacent to Nihon Railway Reisha and Iwafune Inari Shrine.<ref>『近畿日本鉄道100th year のあゆみ』p.572 2010th year  近畿日本鉄道</ref>
* {{ill|Aizu Railway Shrine|ja|会津鉄道神社}} – Shrine located in front of Ashinomaki-Onsen Station in Aizuwakamatsu City, Fukushima Prefecture.
* {{ill|Shinano Railway Shrine|ja|しなの鉄道神社}} – Shrine located within Karuizawa Station in Karuizawa Town, Kitasaku District, Nagano Prefecture.
* {{ill|Shinshimashima Station Railway Shrine|ja|新島々駅鉄道神社}} – Shrine located within Shinshimashima Station in Matsumoto City, Nagano Prefecture.
* {{ill|Hitachinaka Kaiun Railway Shrine|ja|ひたちなか開運鉄道神社}} – Shrine located within Ajigaura Station in Hitachinaka City, Ibaraki Prefecture.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://ibarakinews.jp/news/newsdetail.php?f_jun=16241069152866|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210620010818/https://ibarakinews.jp/news/newsdetail.php?f_jun=16241069152866|title=「キハ222」がご神体 「鉄道神社」誕生祝う レール製鳥居も|newspaper=茨城新聞|date=2021-06-20|accessdate=2021-06-20|archivedate=2021-06-20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://nordot.app/778873326079115264|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210620013558/https://nordot.app/778873326079115264|title=引退車両をご神体に鉄道神社建立 茨城、交通安全御利益PR|newspaper=共同通信|date=2021-06-19|accessdate=2021-06-20|archivedate=2021-06-20}}</ref>

== Shrines closely associated with railways ==
* {{ill|Kumanodaira Shrine|ja|熊ノ平神社}} – Shrine at former Kumanodaira Station, JR Ichinomiya.
* {{ill|Tanna Shrine|ja|丹那神社}} – Shrine honoring those who died constructing the Tanna Tunnel.
* {{ill|Shutetsu Shrine|ja|守鐡社}} – Shrine dedicated to railway protection in front of Mooka Station.
* {{ill|Senmori Inari Shrine|ja|線守稲荷神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Senmori Inari Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11607954}}
* {{ill|Torigoe Inari Shrine|ja|鳥越稲荷神社}} – Shrine located within Shimonoe Station.
* {{ill|Kayashima Shrine|ja|萱島神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kayashima Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11620508}} – Shrine located under Kayashima Station in Neyagawa City, Osaka Prefecture. Revived by Keihan Electric Railway during station expansion.
* Transportation Shrine – Shrine located within {{ill|Amu Plaza Miyazaki|ja|アミュプラザみやざき|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Amu Plaza Miyazaki|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q104759127}} in Miyazaki City, Miyazaki Prefecture.
